model_annotation: This chart is a nested donut (ring) chart consisting of two concentric rings that represent two different measures of ambiguity: the outer ring displays "Ambiguity Std" and the inner ring displays "Max Ambiguity." The outer ring contains four slices corresponding to different standard deviation values: "Std: 0.0" shown in dark teal/navy at 49.0%, "Std: 0.47" in a medium-dark blue at 39.0%, "Std: 0.82" in a medium blue at 7.0%, and "Std: 0.94" in a lighter blue at 5.0%. The inner ring contains three slices representing maximum ambiguity levels: "Max: 1" in a light blue at 47.7%, "Max: 2" in a pale/light blue at 38.0%, and "Max: 3" in a very pale blue at 14.2%. Percentage labels are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice. Two separate legends are provided to the right of the chart, one for each ring, with color swatches matching the corresponding slices. The color scheme progresses from darker blues for lower ambiguity standard deviation values to lighter blues for higher values in the outer ring, and from a medium light blue to progressively paler blues as the max ambiguity increases in the inner ring. In both rings, the slices appear to be arranged roughly in descending order of size moving clockwise.
